L_t = K_t + sum_(s ∉ O_t) min(d_s(t),0) - r_t
U_t = K_t + sum_(s ∉ O_t) max(d_s(t),0) + r_t

sections.heading: Causal replay results reverse the greedy ranking
paragraphs: The frozen analysis reads all 168 old paths from twelve authored deterministic templates. Its neutral-versus-selective contrast uses 24 path records per horizon, or 48 across the two horizons; these records still refer to the same twelve templates. Three causal policies, four quote caps and two horizons yield 24 dependent replay configurations, 180 checkpoint decisions and 540 panel-bound rows. A separately written verifier integrates unit recovery-cost intervals, recomputes all bounds and decisions, and exhausts 744 candidate subsets across eight cap/horizon oracle contracts. Every bound contains the complete-data contrast; interval widths do not increase.

The clairvoyant comparator is computed by dynamic programming over queried-state subsets and checkpoint arrivals. It is allowed to skip a checkpoint and can use the final coefficient to choose which visible state to quote, but it cannot quote a state before arrival or use more than one slot per checkpoint. Its final-width minimum is independently checked by enumerating subsets and matching each sorted first-arrival time to a distinct available checkpoint. This lower bound isolates the information disadvantage; it is not a deployable policy, not a Bayesian optimum and not an outcome-specific minimum sign certificate.

At B=5 and q=4, current_disagreement reaches final width 1/15, equal to the arrival-constrained oracle. FIFO and prefix_abs both end at width 2/15. Prefix_abs uses only three of the four available quote units because the remaining visible prefix coefficients cancel when earlier slots are offered. All three rules obey the same cap; a cap is an upper bound rather than a command to spend a useless query. The unused credit and wider endpoint are both retained, rather than imputing an unexecuted fourth query.

The ordering reverses at B=8. With one quote, FIFO attains width 1/8 whereas prefix_abs and current_disagreement reach 1/6, a 1/24 disadvantage in width. With four quotes, prefix_abs reaches 1/24, FIFO 1/12 and current_disagreement 1/8; the oracle reaches zero. Thus the largest-past-coefficient rule can be worse than FIFO at a small cap and better at a larger cap on the same horizon. V15's exchange proof assumes fixed final coefficients and supplies no optimality guarantee for these evolving coefficients.

A narrower terminal width is not automatically an earlier sign certificate. Of the 24 replay configurations, two certify the positive unaffected contrast: current_disagreement at B=5/q=4, checkpoint 5, and prefix_abs at B=8/q=4, checkpoint 8. Both use four quotes. The initial and later contrasts remain zero, and none of the causal rules reaches an exact tie certificate within these caps. Every unreached target keeps a null first-checkpoint and null query count with the spent cap/quotes retained. These counts are inspection of cached utilities, not measured audit executions or natural recovery successes.

Parentheses retain actual queries. Oracle knows final coefficients and is a lower bound; all other policies use prefix information only.

sections.heading: Method comparison and a prospective admission test
paragraphs: Golovin and Krause's adaptive-submodularity framework [21] makes the policy depend on observed selected-item outcomes under a prior over realizations. We adopt the explicit partial-information boundary, but implement no Bayesian posterior or adaptive-submodularity approximation algorithm. Our final weights are revealed by future commits, and neither diminishing returns under a suitable realization model nor its required conditions is established. The author v5 revision also explicitly weakens a coverage guarantee after a proof flaw. We therefore do not describe our prefix heuristic as inheriting a general greedy guarantee.

The official COCO performance-assessment exposition [16] distinguishes fixed-budget indicator values from the evaluations needed to attain a target, retaining undefined runtimes for targets that are not reached. We similarly report final width at a quote cap separately from first sign/point checkpoint and quote count, but run no COCO functions, optimizer or restart protocol. In particular, checkpoint cost is recovery-stream geometry while a quote is a cached-state inspection; neither is presented as measured CPU/model latency or an externally comparable objective-call speedup.

The executable next experiment must freeze an audit selector before a genuinely unobserved commit stream begins, record each information view and decision, and log actual state execution calls, cache hits, failures and elapsed audit time separately. Recovery workers and audit allocations require different denominators. Replay feasibility is now checked; prospective operational cost and population recovery effects remain unmeasured. A claim of online savings is stopped if future commits or terminal coefficients enter the selector, or if repeated full-state/input audits disagree.

sections.heading: robust allocation needs an explicit continuation class
paragraphs: The v16 ranking reversal leaves a methodological question: can a robust rule protect against an unknown continuation, or does it only optimize a convenient forecast? We retain the full 168 frozen paths and the same neutral-minus-selective contrast over twelve equal-weight authored template pairs at each horizon. No correction worker changes. The public audit contract is also unchanged: one previously unqueried visible state per integer checkpoint, no t=0 query, and at most q distinct-state quotes for q=1, 2, 3, 4. A quote reveals old saved fixed-panel values, not a new audit execution.

A selector receives only the horizon B, checkpoint t, commits visible through t, normalized prefix coefficients p, current arm-frequency difference d, first-arrival times and its own queried state identities. Future commits, terminal coefficients, source-program contents and utility payloads are absent. The remaining length is r=(B-t)/B. Unknown outcomes are disclosed to the interval evaluator only after a selection. Decisions are invariant when hidden future events and utility payloads are replaced while this visible view remains fixed.

First consider an unrestricted continuation that can transition arbitrarily soon to fresh state identities. The supremum worst final conditional audit-only width after querying set A is the unqueried prefix L1 mass plus 2 r. The upper bound is the triangle inequality. For the converse, future arm occupations can approach disjoint fresh states not in A; their opposing masses contribute 2 r without canceling any past state. This is a supremum or closure argument when the view already includes commits at t. We do not claim the supremum is attained under a positive minimum future commit delay. A single currently available query removes exactly its absolute prefix coefficient, so unrestricted one-step minimax is precisely prefix_abs, rather than a new universally stronger selector.

To obtain a different comparator we declare a narrower diagnostic class. Its final coefficient vector is c(lambda)=p+lambda*r*d with a common lambda from zero to one. Current arm occupations persist for that fraction of the remaining horizon and then their contrast cancels. This is a structured hypothetical continuation, not an inferred probability distribution or a claim that future states are confined to the nine eventually observed identities. The class can be wrong; its coverage of the saved terminal vector is tested separately.

For each final coefficient scenario, the residual binary-utility audit interval has width equal to the unqueried L1 mass. We minimize the worst such conditional width over the restricted segment. Convexity places its maximum at lambda zero or one, so exact evaluation requires the larger of two endpoint widths. This is not the width of the union of intervals when lambda itself remains unknown: known-state contributions can also shift with lambda. We use the restricted quantity to choose a query, never to certify a final sign or replace the unrestricted prefix-plus-suffix interval.

restricted_minimax_one selects the available state with the greatest strict immediate reduction in that endpoint maximum, using ascending SHA for ties; if every gain is zero it waits. restricted_minimax_set enumerates subsets of currently visible available states up to the remaining quote cap and public checkpoint opportunities, minimizes the endpoint maximum, prefers fewer quotes and a lexicographically earlier subset, and queries the first member now. It replans at the next checkpoint. The finite subset optimum is exact for that visible static decision, not a globally optimal online policy.

We retain FIFO, prefix_abs and current_disagreement unchanged, add persistence_abs ranking by absolute p+r*d, and add late_prefix. The latter waits until the last q scheduled checkpoints and then applies prefix_abs. It knows the horizon and public opportunity calendar but no future commit contents. All seven selectors share the same arrival rights, q cap and single-query opportunities; doing fewer queries is allowed and charged explicitly. Delayed selectors must pay in certificate timing and intermediate uncertainty, not just a final-width table.
equations: W_("free")(A) = sum_(s in A^c) abs(p_s) + 2 r
W_("restricted")(A) = max(sum_(s in A^c) abs(p_s), sum_(s in A^c) abs(p_s + r d_s))

sections.heading: Model misspecification and a complementarity counterexample
paragraphs: The restricted segment fails to contain the actual final coefficient vector in nine of thirteen nonterminal views, including both initial t=0 views. Restricting the denominator to preterminal query checkpoints gives seven violations among eleven views. These views are dependent snapshots of two already exposed aggregate paths, not independent model failures or an estimated misspecification probability. The membership test uses final coefficients only in retrospective evaluation; it is never an input to a selector. Every reported sign certificate and truth-containing bound continues to use the unrestricted future suffix.

Membership is checked coordinate by coordinate over the union of prefix, current and terminal state identities. For a nonzero slope, every coordinate requires the same lambda; zero-slope coordinates must already equal the final coefficient. We also minimize L1 distance to the segment over its exact piecewise-linear knots. At B=5, views t=0 through 3 are outside; at B=8, views t=0 through 4 are outside. The terminal views are trivially inside because r=0 and the prefix is then complete. Including those terminal identities as favorable predictive examples would hide the relevant limitation.

A separate four-state construction exposes a planning issue even when the restricted model is accepted. Let the two endpoint coefficient vectors be(1/4, -1/4, 0, 0) and(0, 0, 1/4, -1/4). The worst conditional width is1/2. Querying only state a or only state c leaves that worst width 1/2, whereas querying both reduces it to1/4. The marginal gain of c is therefore zero initially and 1/4 after a. This violates diminishing returns for the resulting robust width-reduction set function; a rule that stops on zero immediate gain can miss a useful pair.

The construction is algebraically compatible with zero-sum coefficient vectors and a remaining fraction 1/2: the implied active-frequency difference is(-1/2, 1/2, 1/2, -1/2). It is a deliberately authored counterexample, not a thirteenth natural history or an observed common failure. It does not refute conditional adaptive-submodularity results [21]; it shows that our objective lacks a property that such a guarantee would require us to establish. Exact visible-set enumeration is a transparent small comparator for this gap.

sections.heading: A late-query control improves final width and delays information
paragraphs: The new replay has 56 policy/horizon/cap configurations, 420 decisions and 1, 260 safe bound rows over three fixed panels. The prior 24 terminal contracts reproduce exactly. Author-written separate verification reconstructs all prefix occupations directly from raw unit intervals, enumerates 483 candidate subsets by bit masks, checks 1, 235 convex-breakpoint evaluations and independently confirms all eight arrival-oracle contracts. These are computations on the same exposed authored inputs, not independent scientific repetitions.

At B=8 and q=3, late-prefix queries at checkpoints six, seven and eight, reaches final width 1/24 with zero arrival-oracle regret, and certifies the unaffected positive contrast at checkpoint eight. Restricted one-query and restricted-set rules reach width 1/12, regret 1/24 and no certificate within the horizon. Their query checkpoints are four, five and six. The timing tradeoff is retained: normalized checkpoint width area is75/64 for late-prefix versus 37/32 for restricted-set. Narrowing the final interval by waiting does not establish a better anytime auditor or a reduction in actual worker latency.

The quote count remains three in both B=8/q=3 comparisons. The terminal gain therefore concerns when a fixed query allowance is used, rather than extra quote spending. The area is a declared discrete left-step summary: sum the safe width at checkpoints zero through B-1 and divide by B. It is not continuous-time expected recovery, elapsed worker latency or a sampling confidence sequence. FIFO at that same contract also has area 37/32 and width 1/12. A final-width-only ranking omits the period during which an auditor has less information.

The opposite boundary is visible at B=8/q=1. FIFO queries at t=1 and late-prefix at t=8; both finish at width 1/8, while their checkpoint width areas are 75/64 and 19/16. Waiting gives no terminal improvement there and has the worse area. At B=5/q=4, current disagreement, persistence and both restricted minimax rules tie at width 1/15 and an unaffected positive certificate at t=5. Prefix_abs and late-prefix use only three effective queries and remain at width 2/15. These caps are upper bounds, not a forced equal number of useful actions.

In all eight final-width contracts, persistence_abs and the two restricted minimax rules tie. Their decision sequences and areas can differ: at B=8/q=3, restricted-set improves the checkpoint area by1/192 relative to restricted-one without changing final width 1/12. Thus additional finite planning has a narrow timing effect in this bank but establishes no better terminal width. Candidate-set work is reported separately from cache quotes:483 nonempty sets are evaluated along primary decisions, excluding repeated invariance checks, author verification and the clairvoyant oracle. No hardware-speed or model-cost saving is inferred.

sections.heading: Comparators, safety bounds and a prospective robustness test
paragraphs: The official revised adaptive-submodularity paper defines policies from partial observations and conditions greedy guarantees on structural assumptions [21]. We reopen its primary HTML policy and diminishing-returns sections; our robust counterexample is a direct local calculation, not a reproduction of that paper. We also reopen official COCO assessment guidance [16] to preserve fixed-budget quality versus target-attainment distinctions. Its optimization benchmark and reported performance are not executed or imported. The absent-target entries here remain null with query spending retained.

A clairvoyant arrival-constrained oracle sees the completed coefficient vector, obeys the same available state arrivals and one-query schedule, and lower-bounds the final residual width. It is not an online competitor with the same information. Unrestricted minimax equivalence applies to one current query against arbitrary future states, while restricted minimax applies to a declared continuation segment. Neither statement proves competitive online regret, calibrated confidence coverage or robustness of the actual complete-state assumption.

The current safety contract still assumes complete visible commits, full state identity, deterministic fixed-input panel utilities and no hidden mutation. Restricted-model misspecification is diagnosed without invalidating the separate unrestricted suffix bound inside that contract. In an actual stochastic or partially hidden executor even that underlying contract must be tested; an exposed arithmetic fixture cannot certify it. New actual audits, worker calls, natural histories and independently reserved prospective streams remain zero; prospective audit effect is null.

A next prospective test should freeze policy and continuation class before new commits arrive, log the exact selector view and available opportunities, and compare late/FIFO controls alongside any robust optimizer. It should report the final safe width, the checkpoint uncertainty area, target-attainment time, spent and failed quotes, cache hits, model/worker invocations and elapsed latency separately. It must audit full-state/input repeatability and reject deterministic reuse when hidden state or drift is observed. The present unfavorable model coverage and comparator results are admission tests for that design, not proof that robust auditing is useless in other settings.

sections.heading: Unknown continuation scenarios change the audit objective
paragraphs: The continuation distinguishes the worst width conditional on a fixed scenario, the union of identification intervals when the scenario itself is unknown, and a pre-outcome worst union objective used for utility-blind audit selection. The last has four endpoint-pair cases; a two-state analytic construction separates zero conditioned width from union width1/2. This mathematical construction must not be substituted for observed incidence.

On all1,620 actual fixed-panel views in the saved development traces, actual union width equals worst conditioned width. The empirical premium is zero even though pre-outcome counterfactual objectives can differ. A supplementary envelope check enumerates1,104 visible subsets and11,159 known-utility vertices; unreachable historical audit subsets are explicitly separated from causally arrival-feasible choices.

Two new union-aware deterministic rules use the same visible prefix, arrival opportunities and quote caps as the seven preserved controls. All16 new-rule/cap paired contracts tie their corresponding restricted rules in final safe width. Four B8 areas improve by exactly1/192 at unchanged query checkpoints and quote counts; twelve areas tie. These repeated authored replay contrasts are not independent gains, actual elapsed audit savings or new unaffected-state certificates.

sections.heading: Discussion and Limitations
paragraphs: The practical lesson is a decision rule: do not promote a recovered score, candidate or skill until the integrated state has been observed under the corrected contract and preserved capabilities have been checked. This is a measurement requirement supported by constructed counterexamples. It is not evidence that the proposed lineage-first procedure should replace the neutral control.

sections.heading: Identification assumptions and threats to validity
paragraphs: Construction is the dominant limitation. One author defines arithmetic inputs, candidate programs, the evaluator defect, lineage and harmful lesson routing. Eight histories contain a useful rejected candidate and four do not. Those proportions, the aligned/misleading balance and the recovery counts are experimental choices and consequences, not deployment incidence estimates. The same few inputs recur throughout; researcher-visible audit answers prevent any independent final-test interpretation.

Complete-state reconstruction is conditional. Files, retrievers, caches, tool responses, external services and latent or stochastic model state could invalidate the claim that utility stays fixed between logged commits. A same-state disagreement, an unknown state mutation, a missing positive-duration audit or a violation of the bound must suspend a point estimate. For stochastic agents, state-level repeated sampling and a declared expectation/uncertainty model are needed; one observed answer does not identify capability.

The later-input panel runs the same final state on a different authored input. No further training, candidate evolution or calendar-time drift occurs. The historical field strict_recurrence is therefore a maintenance-failure statistic across these panels, not long-term evolutionary recurrence. Similarly, exact local hashes support integrity checks, not external authorship signatures, scientific correctness or conference acceptance.

sections.heading: What fails without complete logs or deterministic equality
paragraphs: The positive identification results retain complete commit times even when utility audits are withheld. If that condition is removed and arbitrary hidden continuous-time state changes are allowed between finite checkpoint observations, those observations do not bound the area away from zero or one. In every gap we construct a path matching the left observation for a gap/1000 neighborhood, a low or high utility in the interior, and the right observation near the next checkpoint. The two paths agree at every retained audit but have normalized areas at most 0.002 and at least 0.998. The construction is checked for all 504 trajectory-panel objects. The sharp closed region is therefore the full unit interval as the neighborhoods shrink; exact endpoint attainment under right-continuity is not asserted.

This counterexample deliberately removes an integer-only commit lattice and permits otherwise unrestricted hidden-state utility dynamics. If a documented lattice, bounded number of hidden events, minimum dwell time, known transition graph or restricted worker semantics remains available, tighter bounds can follow and must be optimized over that smaller class. We do not claim that every kind of partial logging is vacuous. Nor do these compatible mathematical paths constitute newly executed recovery trajectories or additional natural histories.

Deterministic state equality is a separate assumption. If an apparently identical hash omits environment state, or stochastic outputs are treated as fixed, neutral and selective visits can have different utilities. Equal occupation coefficients then no longer cancel. Two visit-specific utilities zero and one yield a contrast of minus one, while reversing them yields plus one, despite a zero contrast under the shared-variable model. Repeated state audits, environment snapshots and an expectation/uncertainty contract are needed for stochastic agents. A checksum cannot supply them.

sections.heading: A staged real-model confirmation study
paragraphs: The executed negative findings narrow the proposal. Lineage-first ordering should be a conditional hypothesis about trustworthy decision support, with neutral fallback and its cost included. A useful-rejected-candidate gate before integration may address development memorization, but its extra queries, exposure and selection opportunity must be charged. Reusing the final audit labels for that gate would change the evaluation rather than demonstrate improvement. Current-only model retuning should be added as a separately budgeted generation procedure, not described as a native comparison already completed here.

A model feasibility study needs an actually generated versioned candidate archive, real old-grader accept/reject decisions and any lesson the model really wrote. Before correction, freeze the common history, active artifact, preserved later changes and model/runtime/settings. The correction needs independent approval under an unchanged contract. Assign protected task roles and stop rules before generating outcomes; keep no-useful-reject, no-written-lesson, disputed-correction, missing-archive, failed-integration and incomplete-audit histories visible in the flow.

Matched-policy forks must have common data rights and envelopes for selector calls, candidate invocations, input/output tokens, grader calls, integration, lesson editing and audits. A complete model state may include filesystem, tool responses, retrieval indices and environment snapshots beyond a prompt hash. For stochastic outputs, repeated state audits estimate a panel expectation with nested sampling uncertainty; one deterministic fixture output supplies neither a population confidence interval nor a stochastic capability curve. New correction families and evolution prefixes must be clustered rather than treating repeated responses as independent histories.

Only after those conditions are met can the hypotheses concern real recovery or continued-evolution recurrence. A native SkillOpt, Reflexion or Zep comparison additionally needs the original algorithm's declared objective, environment, reset and resource contracts. Until then, our findings concern endpoint design, a fully inspectable constructed failure mechanism and measurement resolution. Model critic feedback, named methodological lenses and successful checksum verification do not close those scientific gates.

sections.heading: Benchmark choice and falsifiable next hypotheses
paragraphs: A feasible first extension is an access-controlled program-edit history over a fixed subset of real issue-resolution tasks. SWE-bench can motivate the environment [18], while EvalPlus motivates additional behavioral tests [17]; neither alone supplies correction labels. Before model use, construct an explicit inclusion flow: unchanged requirement, authenticated old rejection, independent correction approval, available candidate archive, observable current state, and approved audit rights. Preserve failed, disputed and absent-useful-candidate histories in the flow. Repository licenses, runtime feasibility and evaluation exposure must be checked before acquiring or executing a selected dataset.

The primary superiority hypothesis should be conditional on reliable lineage and tested against neutral early-stop, neutral joint repair and a separately budgeted current-only regeneration procedure. A useful-candidate gate must use permitted development data and pay for its extra queries; reusing final audit labels would change the task. The primary recovery endpoint should be fresh integrated-state utility on independently held histories, with preserved-capability loss and total model/tool resources as co-primary costs. The stopping rule, smallest relevant effect and interval procedure should be set before model outcomes, rather than obtained by treating 168 nested paths as independent observations.

Long-term recurrence requires another declared evolution prefix after repair, with new decisions, lessons and resource/exposure records. It is a separate future experiment. The current design will be rejected or revised if neutral procedures retain their advantage on the declared target, if lineage fails to localize useful rejections, if the state snapshot cannot support reproducible audits, or if additional intervention cost outweighs any independently measured behavioral gain.

sections.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: Evaluator correction, candidate success and current-state recovery are different endpoints. SecondChance makes the distinction executable and exposes a strong neutral control that ties recovery and can avoid unnecessary cost and collateral loss. Its frozen-path follow-up shows that coarse utility sampling can miss both recovery and degradation; under complete deterministic state logs, freshly observed commits identify a stepwise area with an explicit geometry bound. The supported contribution is an auditable measurement and comparison contract with retained negative results. Natural LLM recovery, native-method superiority and long-term recurrence remain unmeasured.

Controlled censoring adds a precise distinction: a policy contrast may remain exactly or one-sided identified even when separate recovery areas are not. Signed state-occupation bounds and exhaustive audit-set certificates quantify that robustness in this exposed fixture. The same analysis exposes its failure boundaries: unknown commit timing and invalid deterministic-state equality can destroy identification. These are measurement findings and future audit requirements, not a demonstrated real-agent recovery advantage.

V15 supplies a concrete utility-blind audit order for the known-path setting and verifies its exact width objective. Its five/four-query exact certificates and four/three-query positive-sign stopping costs must remain distinct from hindsight minima, true online scheduling and actual audit latency. Natural correction histories and complete deterministic state observations remain the empirical admission gates.

V16 executes decisions without future commits and bounds the unknown suffix explicitly. Causal replay reveals different winners at different horizons and query caps, while a same-prefix/opposite-future construction prevents universal early sign certification. The advance is an executable information contract and an exact finite comparison; prospective acquisition cost, natural correction-policy effects and broader scheduler guarantees remain open.

V17 adds a conditional minimax objective, an exact misspecification check and a delayed-query control. Stronger-looking optimization does not automatically beat simple scheduling: late-prefix attains a narrower B=8/q=3 final interval than both restricted minimax rules, but waits longer with higher checkpoint width area. Conditional continuation robustness, unknown-scenario identification and actual prospective audit efficiency remain distinct claims. The latter still requires new independent instrumentation and natural histories.

V19 separates scenario-conditioned, realized scenario-union and pre-outcome union objectives. The observed premium is zero in all 1,620 panel comparisons. Across the sixteen paired new-rule contracts, final safe widths all tie; only four checkpoint areas improve, each by 1/192. A zero-sum L1 continuation tube adds an exact common width term under stated free-coordinate conditions and therefore cannot alter candidate ranking. Increasing empirical inclusion is a descriptive sensitivity result, not a coverage guarantee. The next test requires prospectively reserved paths and measured audit costs.

appendices.heading: Proof details and missing observations
paragraphs: Fix an audit input and suppose every state-changing event is logged; the executor is a pure deterministic function of the complete recorded state; and every state occupying positive cost width has a fresh valid audit. Partition [0,B) at the state commits. State and input remain constant on each half-open interval, so utility is constant and its integral equals utility times interval width. Summing yields A_C. Endpoint-only states require a separate terminal observation even though their contribution to area is zero.

For a coarse interval [g_j,g_(j+1)), a grid-aligned commit is included in the state at its left endpoint. If the first strictly interior state-changing commit is t_j, actual and left-sampled utilities are equal on [g_j,t_j). On the remaining interval their difference has absolute value at most one. The absolute integral error is therefore bounded by its length; the triangle inequality over cells and division by B gives E. Extra commits can cancel error but cannot violate this bound. With utilities in [L,H], multiply E by H-L. A single persistent jump at t_j attains the bound.

For missing positive-width observations, let W_unknown be their total width and sum only known contributions as A_observed. With utilities in [0,1], area lies in [A_observed, A_observed + W_unknown/B]; retain null for an unidentified point estimate. Missing endpoint-only audits do not create area width and do not authorize filling in a terminal score. Unknown commits or incompletely captured environments invalidate the partition itself, rather than merely increasing a conventional standard error.
